name: Eye of the Vortex
summary: Located near the ancient ruins of Ameth'Aran, the Eye of the Vortex is a turbulent convergence point where elemental air whips into violent tempests along the Darkshore coastline. The wild squalls and churning winds here pose an ongoing hazard to travelers and mark a place where the primal forces of nature remain unstable.

sections.title: A Tempest Unleashed
sections.body: Situated near the haunted elven ruins of Ameth'Aran, the Eye of the Vortex sits amidst the battered landscape of Darkshore. Here, raging winds and restless air elementals swirl into an unrelenting squall. The volatile currents threaten any who stray too close, howling through the twisted pines and battering the crags with unrestrained natural fury.

faq.q: What is the Eye of the Vortex?
faq.answer: It is a turbulent area in central Darkshore near the ruins of Ameth'Aran, characterized by violent, swirling winds and hostile air elementals.

faq.q: Where is the Eye of the Vortex located?
aliases: where is eye of the vortex
faq.answer: It lies in the wilderness of central Darkshore, situated just near the ancient night elven ruins of Ameth'Aran.

faq.q: Why are there air elementals here?
faq.answer: The elemental spirits of wind and weather are drawn to areas of severe turbulence and unrest, feeding into the squall that churns along Darkshore's craggy hills.

faq.q: Is the vortex dangerous to travel through?
aliases: can i walk into the vortex
faq.answer: Yes. The swirling gales and hostile elemental denizens make traversing the immediate area treacherous for unwary travelers and couriers heading through Darkshore.

angles.text: The wild, uncontrolled winds here are a reminder of how easily nature can slip out of balance when primal forces churn unchecked.
The agitation of the elemental wind spirits at this site offers a clear sign of elemental discord disturbing the coast.
